message.content: Why did you cap the retries at five?

content.text: Full-jitter backoff from 200 ms because the upstream's 429 budget resets every 60 s and 40 pods retrying in lockstep re-spike it; capped at 5 the worst-case backoff is 6.2 s, under the 10 s gateway timeout, while a sixth attempt takes it to 12.6 s.
